schema_version.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Stage A — reconstruct and freeze, machine-readable manifest; schema_version: chosen schema version 1.0 for the required manifest; SLICE-02 fixes no schema version.

fee_series.value: raw redeemed ETH; no Explorer sender exclusions; use only round 4364, not 30-day averages

usd_usdc_replay.value: For every pool i, baseline gross USDC_i = (round fees_eth_i / round fees_eth_total) * round fees_usd_indexed. Treat indexed USD as hypothetical USDC at 1:1; retain all 100 pools. This is settlement scale, not measured USDC invoices or demand.
usd_usdc_replay.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Inputs to freeze at Stage A, paragraph after the table; usd_usdc_replay: chosen 1:1 indexed-USD/hypothetical-USDC conversion preserving round ETH fee shares, within the requirement to name a replay assumption; no measured USDC claim.

network_denominators.value: Sum all 100 round pools after every intervention. No capability-specific pool, no normalization of MFS weights. Other 98 remain in every fee/stake and issuance denominator. No 30-day history series is consumed.
network_denominators.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p3 L123-150; network-snapshot/README.md

selection_rule.value: Exclude the address documented in /identity_context/0; among positive-fee pools separately below and above round-4364 fee_share versus stake_share, choose the largest same-round stake_share, breaking ties by lexical address. Use no payoff, cost, capture rank, ENS, presumed owner or future outcome to select. The community/grants exclusion is moot at round 4364 because that address has zero fee and fails the positive-fee condition; A/B selection is unchanged with or without it.

value.reason: Documented community/grants role; exclude from selected interventions. Retain its pool in full network accounting. At round 4364 this address has zero fee, so a rule that needs positive fee could not have selected it; the exclusion did not alter the selection.

ownership_proxy.value: For every pool use capture-time operator_address_fraction_of_own_pool as w at round 4364. Applying it backwards is illustrative; not total organization stake or beneficial ownership. Other-address receipts are treated as outside this accounting boundary, not proven unrelated ownership. Selected A/B controlled payers are synthetic role assumptions; no allegation about these addresses.

outside_delegators.value: Show other-address receipts explicitly and exclude them from the organization take. Organization operator-role commission plus its declared w share of delegator remainder is retained; no organization validator or treasury receipt.
outside_delegators.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, paragraph beginning Apply operator fee and reward cuts; outside_delegators: exclusion of outside receipts is required; other-address stake is chosen as the outside-boundary proxy, not measured beneficial ownership.

cuts_rule.value: Use each earning-round operator_reward_cut_fraction k and delegator_fee_share_fraction d. Operator commission: k * node reward and (1-d) * node-side fee; own-address delegator part: w*(1-k)*reward and w*d*node-side fee; outside-address remainder separately. Never call commission-only receipt the whole organization receipt.
cuts_rule.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p3 L150-153; /rounds/34/pools; network-snapshot/read_snapshot.py

validator_treasury_mint.value: Validator and treasury shares of each round's emissions are minted in full.

validator_recipient_allocation.source: VD-17; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p4 L197-201 / p13 L655-664; later validator study

schedule_r.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, paragraph beginning For a declared round since launch; schedule_r: chosen r=0 calibration, permitted measured-round calibration; numerical r is not fixed by SLICE-02.

emission_base_calibration.value: Use /rounds/34/scheduled_mint_ceiling_lpt as hypothetical EmissionBase at r=0, as EX-05. Hold this one-round cohort ceiling across all comparisons, including the later claim horizons. Deployed round 4364 is not rounds since hypothetical launch.
emission_base_calibration.source: october-reconciliation/README.md Sources and rule interpretations; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p7 L388-395

schedule_governance.source: VD-14; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p9 L472-476 / p13 L672-686

mfs_entitlement.value: 0.94 * E * min(f_i/F, s_i/S) * m_i; median applied once at claim; all other pools computed independently against full network totals.
mfs_entitlement.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p3 L134-150; p4 L203-208; p8 L413-416

mfs_unused.value: Never mint node allowance not allocated under MFS; never redistribute it to rivals or accusers.

score_withheld_mint.value: Mint node rewards only at actual claim. Under full claim, score-withheld amount is never minted and separately labelled as a model interpretation. Keep MFS-unallocated, score-withheld and pending claimable portions separately; pending does not expire.
score_withheld_mint.source: VD-12; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p8 L413-416; p6 L271-276

appendix_control.value: One matched S10 intervention plus its S00 reference: work interpreted as fee share; allocate 0.94*E*(f_i/F*m_i)/sum_j(f_j/F*m_j), no stake cap and no second claim multiplier. Full scores only, same ceiling/cuts/cost/ownership/claim/burn. Normalized fee-work is a possible reading, not resolved paper policy. Zero normalization is undefined.
appendix_control.source: VD-06; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p13 L646-653; M2.1 I-03 historical reading

lpt_valuation_price.source: /prices/lpt_usd_spot; indexed USD replay 1:1; october-reconciliation/README.md Valuation assumption

burn_execution_price.source: /prices/lpt_usd_spot; idealized fixed execution; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p6 L298-307

burn_market_boundary.value: No appreciation, liquidity effect, slippage, market-impact, taxes, transaction or financing cost is computed; explicit zero-cost analytical controls, not observed free execution. Value unsold LPT separately from cash; do not count a sale and its tokens twice. Manipulation costs remain for the LPT-price study.

baseline_score.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, paragraph beginning Limit the main table; baseline_score: score 1 is explicitly required as the comparison baseline.

adverse_score.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, paragraph beginning Limit the main table; adverse_score: chosen adverse-score bound 0 within the paper 0–1 multiplier range; SLICE-02 requires one stated adverse bound but fixes no value.

score_set.value: Supply aggregate medians directly, as if every active validator submits and the median is unambiguous. No missing-score, quorum, self-score, recusal or capture model. Adverse bound affects A entire earning-round reward, including outside jobs; apply equally to useful S07 and no-use S08. It is not a detection probability or a justified finding.
score_set.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p4 L203-208; VD-09; docs/m2/SLICE-02.md Finite scenario sequence

earliest_claim.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p6 L271-278 / p12 L599-601

baseline_claim.value: All nodes claim round n at n+7 at score 1; validator/treasury full allocation attributed to the same cohort, not necessarily same timestamp.
baseline_claim.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, paragraph beginning Claimable is not already minted; baseline_claim: chosen all-node full-claim baseline at paper earliest n+7; SLICE-02 permits full claim and requires its horizon stated.

delayed_unclaimed_claim.value: In separate variants of S08, only A waits until n+14, or makes no claim through n+14. Others claim n+7; score remains 1. Report both n+7 and n+14 horizons, A pending claimable separately. No expiry, forfeiture, recovery or compounding presumed; never-claim means indefinite pending entitlement under this control, not proof of permanent unminting.
delayed_unclaimed_claim.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, paragraph beginning Claimable is not already minted; delayed_unclaimed_claim: chosen A-only n+14 and unclaimed variants within the required separate delayed/unclaimed sensitivity; no numeric late horizon or expiry fixed by SLICE-02.

score_recovery.source: VD-11; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p6 L271-278; later score/claim study

stake_snapshot.value: Use round-4364 stake and earning-round cuts, frozen before synthetic interventions at n; pending or claimed rewards do not feed this one-round comparison stake/votes. No stake movement response chosen.
stake_snapshot.source: VD-05 VD-31; /rounds/34/pools; docs/m2/SLICE-02.md Shared accounting contract

stake_delay_phrases.value: 21 rounds (unbonding, L233-244 and p12 L592-597), 21 day period / 21-day transfer wait (L248-258), 21-round movement question (L525-526); do not equate days with rounds. No instant move assumed; fresh capital is not barred. Actual movement speed remains P1 / delegation study.
stake_delay_phrases.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p5 L231-258 / p10 L525-526 / p12 L592-601

synthetic_job_unit.value: One divisible normalized completed-job equivalent. Counts may be fractional to preserve measured fee shares; common volume unit across generic and niche, not equivalent resource consumption. No actual job count, capability or demand observation.
synthetic_job_unit.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Inputs to freeze at Stage A, Price, volume and cost row; synthetic_job_unit: chosen divisible normalized completed-job equivalent within the requirement for synthetic units and transparent fee-to-price-times-volume mapping.

generic_price.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Inputs to freeze at Stage A, Price, volume and cost row; generic_price: chosen positive 1 USDC/job normalization; SLICE-02 requires explicit illustrative price, fixes no numeric price.

discount_price.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 1 Ordinary competition; discount_price: chosen 0.5 USDC/job unilateral discount below the 1-USDC baseline; SLICE-02 requires discount comparison, fixes no discount size.

generic_unit_cost.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, first paragraph; generic_unit_cost: chosen independent nonnegative 0.30 USDC/job execution cost; SLICE-02 fixes cost independence from price, not its numeric value.

generic_setup_cost.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, first paragraph; generic_setup_cost: chosen nonnegative zero generic setup cost, declared separately; SLICE-02 fixes no setup-cost value.

generic_capacity.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Stage A — reconstruct and freeze, first paragraph; generic_capacity: chosen positive finite capacity 1000 generic job-equivalents/pool/round; SLICE-02 requires an explicit capacity boundary, fixes no number.

baseline_outside_jobs.value: For every pool q0_i = hypothetical baseline gross USDC_i / generic_price; q_self=0. Attribute all baseline jobs to synthetic outside customers for this cooperative reference, not as measured customer independence.
baseline_outside_jobs.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 0 Cooperative; baseline_outside_jobs: chosen q0=fee replay/generic price with zero controlled jobs; SLICE-02 requires snapshot scale and synthetic job decomposition, not observed counts or independent demand.

baseline_outside_use.value: Useful service is stipulated; no customer utility dollars enter operator income.
baseline_outside_use.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 0 Cooperative; baseline_outside_use: useful outside service is required as the cooperative reference; customer utility valuation is excluded by this chosen operator-income boundary.

niche_provider.value: A only; existing A address adds a capability, no new pool or new stake. A models capability entry, not empirical access for a newly registered node.
niche_provider.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 2 Capability entry; niche_provider: chosen A-only capability entry at an existing selected pool, within the sole-provider comparison and at-most-two-selected-operators bound.

niche_price.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Inputs to freeze at Stage A, Price, volume and cost row; niche_price: chosen positive 1 USDC/niche job; SLICE-02 requires an explicit capability price and fixes no value.

niche_unit_cost.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, first paragraph; niche_unit_cost: chosen independent nonnegative 0.20 USDC/niche job; SLICE-02 requires capability-specific cost where needed, fixes no value.

niche_setup_cost.unit: USDC/round charged once in each entry comparison
niche_setup_cost.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 2 Capability entry; niche_setup_cost: chosen nonnegative 2-USDC setup charged once per niche comparison; SLICE-02 requires stated setup cost, fixes no number.

niche_capacity.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 2 Capability entry; niche_capacity: chosen finite capacity 20 niche job-equivalents/round; SLICE-02 requires a capacity boundary, fixes no number.

niche_jobs.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 2 Capability entry; niche_jobs: chosen 10 niche job-equivalents, within the separately declared capacity 20; SLICE-02 fixes no volume.

niche_outside_demand.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 2 Capability entry; niche_outside_demand: chosen useful outside niche demand 10 job-equivalents only in S04, within capacity 20; not an empirical demand observation or a SLICE-02 numeric value.

internal_use_value.unit: USDC-equivalent/job of useful internal production/testing; value only, never cash
internal_use_value.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, first paragraph; internal_use_value: chosen nonnegative internal use value 1 USDC-equivalent/job, separate from cash; SLICE-02 requires it stated but fixes no numeric value.

no_use_value.unit: USDC-equivalent/job; illustrative absence of credited use, not observed waste
no_use_value.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 2 Capability entry; no_use_value: zero credited use value implements the required no-assumed-use-value control; SLICE-02 fixes this absence of credited value, not observed lack of benefit.

controlled_added_jobs.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 3 Controlled purchases; controlled_added_jobs: chosen 10 additional real job-equivalents under declared capacity and invoice budget, with matched price/cost/jobs; SLICE-02 fixes no numeric volume.

self_funding_budget.unit: USDC liquid budget per controlled organization/round; invoice outflows bounded by this, not an optimization target
self_funding_budget.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Stage A — reconstruct and freeze, first paragraph; self_funding_budget: chosen finite nonnegative invoice budget 20 USDC per controlled organization/round; SLICE-02 requires an explicit budget, fixes no number.

payer_organization.value: For controlled cases payer and selected provider are one synthetic organization; internal payments cancel against recovered node-side receipts exactly once. Execution costs are paid to external providers; outside delegator receipts and network half are leakage. A and B organizations distinct.
payer_organization.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, paragraph beginning Apply operator fee and reward cuts; payer_organization: chosen synthetic payer/provider organization with distinct A/B groups; exact internal-transfer cancellation and external leakage are required by SLICE-02.

fixed_demand_routing.value: S01 holds every q0 outside allocation fixed despite A discount; no demand elasticity. S03 halves every pool price at fixed q0; fees scale proportionally but costs do not.
fixed_demand_routing.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 1 Ordinary competition; fixed_demand_routing: unchanged outside demand and share-constant network reduction are required; chosen fixed q0 allocations and uniform half-price size are illustrative.

rerouting_fraction.unit: fraction of B baseline generic outside q0
rerouting_fraction.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 1 Ordinary competition; rerouting_fraction: chosen 0.25 fraction within 0–1 and fixed total outside volume; SLICE-02 requires a stated rerouting rule, fixes no fraction.

rerouting_rule.value: S02 reallocates 0.25*q0_B generic outside jobs from B to A after A price falls to 0.5; every other allocation stays q0. A/B are assumed visible, capable, same region and within capacity. Total generic outside volume fixed; no stake preference or observed cheapest-routing law. Controlled additions never crowd out outside jobs.
rerouting_rule.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 1 Ordinary competition; rerouting_rule: chosen B-to-A rerouting under stipulated equal capability/region and capacity; total outside volume preservation is required, no empirical elasticity fixed.

response_rule.value: S11 inherits S08. B matches A generic price 0.5 once at n in a separate counterfactual; equal-price tie rule restores original q0_A and q0_B outside allocations. A retains its 10 controlled generic jobs. All other 98 fixed, cuts/stake/score/ceiling/cost fixed. Recompute whole network once; no equilibrium or future-round forecast.
response_rule.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 4 One response; response_rule: chosen one B price match and original-allocation equal-price tie rule, within the one-response and two-selected-operator limits; no tie rule fixed by SLICE-02.

decline_reference.value: The parent before adding jobs/capability is the feasible decline comparator; charge setup only in entry cases. Also compare useful internal and no-use controlled jobs with matched price, jobs and costs.
decline_reference.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, order 3 Controlled purchases; decline_reference: chosen no-addition parent/ancestor comparison and setup only for entry; matched price/cost/jobs and legitimate references required, parent schema not fixed by SLICE-02.

contribution.value: Rewards should follow real work. Fees generated for honest work, not just stake, should be the primary basis for earning inflationary LPT rewards during the network's bootstrapping phase.
contribution.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p2 L81-84, Design Principles item 1

narrow_allegation.value: Narrow criterion: knowingly making a false job-purpose representation to retain inflation eligibility. Freeze variants S06-N and S08-N only: at n+1 the operator states "These jobs are useful internal release tests" although packet ground truth stipulates they were ordered only for reward eligibility, with no productive/testing use, and the operator knows this. S05 and S07 make the same true representation for genuinely useful testing, which may also earn rewards. Unmodified S06/S08 contain no false representation. All payment/execution/correctness and B economic inputs remain unchanged; validators must establish representation, falsity, knowledge and eligibility purpose separately.
narrow_allegation.source: M2.1 I-20; VD-09 VD-19; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p4 L203-208

broad_allegation.value: Circular funding of real jobs for rewards, with reward purpose the reason for the jobs and no productive/testing use accounting for them. Mixed-purpose useful work stays a boundary. This is a possible criterion, not paper policy; no-use value input alone proves neither purpose nor violation.
broad_allegation.source: M2.1 I-21; VD-09 VD-19; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p4 L203-208

adverse_readings.value: (a) evidence of named violation required, unknown is not adverse; (b) non-explanation by n+7 can permit a procedural cut. Neither is stated policy. Keep claim cells and score consequences separate; no hearing/appeal or mandatory disclosure invented.

evidence_boundary.value: Public records at illustrative n+1 (listing, quote, payment, disclosed control), task terms and authenticated execution/correctness observations at n+2; one voluntary disclosed source bundle at n+5. Niche bundle = production/test plan with linked output use; discount bundle = selection rule/routing log with linked internal test plan. Source authenticity, access, redaction and timing are premises, not a deployed feed. At n+7 close evidence for the first-claim comparison. Truth labels are packet premises, not validator observations.
evidence_boundary.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p5 L218-221; p6 L271-278; docs/m2/SLICE-02.md Stage C; EX-04

evidence_tolerance_handoff.value: Reuse EX-04 tolerances verbatim as the starting ceilings and both keyed judgment readings; Stage C must restate and obtain integrator commit before any matrix/verdict. Report each tolerance individually; no model outcome may set or relax it. Retain known common control only when stipulated/disclosed; do not infer beneficial owners.

tolerance_adaptation.value: Freeze EX-04 false-cut/missed-violation, routine versus one-question/one-response review, and redacted-one-bundle disclosure ceilings. Substitute S05/S07 useful work for SC-23 and S06/S08 plus labelled -N variants for SC-07; extend protection to ordinary outside S04/S02. No relaxed tolerance for niche entry or discounting; adapt source bundle nouns only as specified in evidence_boundary.

social_burden.value: Validators/investigators may surface an allegation and assess obtainable evidence; authorized criteria and evidence burdens unresolved. Operators/engineers control voluntary internal disclosure and can decline; reading (b) can then impose reward uncertainty without proving violation. Describe preparation time, business disclosure, arrival risk and response access qualitatively; no invented dollar values, empirical error or mandatory appeal. Reputation/retaliation effects remain deferred.
social_burden.source: VD-09; SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p4 L193-208; p5 L218-229; docs/m2/SLICE-02.md Stage C

routing_empirics.source: VD-02 VD-20; P1 / broader access study

zero_fee_convention.value: At F=0 set all MFS fee shares to 0; appendix fee-work normalization undefined, no guessed appendix reward. Stake total must remain positive. Validator/treasury full mint rule retained. Free executed jobs retain stipulated costs.
zero_fee_convention.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, paragraph beginning Show the appendix reading; zero_fee_convention: SLICE-02 explicitly fixes zero MFS fee shares and undefined appendix normalization unless another rule is registered; positive stake and unchanged executed jobs are chosen boundary controls.

sensitivity_reference_rule.value: T-price/T-cost/T-ownership/T-valuation compare S08 with decline S02 under the SAME varied condition: apply the changed A offer price (routing fixed), A unit cost, A owned fraction or LPT valuation to both reference and intervention. Added controlled jobs and use value remain intervention-only. T-score compares S07/S08 after the A whole-round cut with original full-score decline S02; do not cut the reference. T-claim compares delayed/unclaimed S08 with original full-claim decline S02 at each horizon. T-appendix compares S10 with S00 using the same entitlement reading. T-zero directly compares free-price S00 control with original priced S00; T-redistribution directly compares rerouted S03 control with original S03. Also report useful/no-use paired differences; do not confuse those with added-job return.
sensitivity_reference_rule.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Finite scenario sequence, paragraph beginning Limit the main table; sensitivity_reference_rule: chosen symmetric exogenous-condition references and intervention-only score/claim changes within the required separate one-factor, no-Cartesian-product bounds; SLICE-02 fixes no exact reference policy.

numerical_policy.value: Stage B uses Decimal precision 60; no rounding synthetic quantities in calculations, display rounding only. Compare sums at absolute tolerance 1e-18 for measured LPT/ETH reconciliation and 1e-12 for synthetic currency/reward conservation. No scenario result is frozen here.
numerical_policy.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Stage B — model, first paragraph and verification paragraph; numerical_policy: chosen Decimal precision 60 and reconciliation tolerances 1e-18/1e-12 for the required standard-library Decimal/invariant implementation; SLICE-02 fixes no precision or tolerance value.

validator_receipt_rule.value: No validator receipt is assigned to a selected operator; the division among validators is deferred.
validator_receipt_rule.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Shared accounting contract, paragraph beginning For a declared round since launch; validator_receipt_rule: selected operator-role income excludes invented validator receipts; recipient division deferred under VD-17.

contribution_reading.value: The paper supplies no independent-customer or subsidy-value criterion; none is imposed.
contribution_reading.source: SRC-LP20-OCT; docs/litepaper-2.0.md PDF p2 L81-84 and p4 L203-208; VD-19; contribution_reading: unresolved reading of eligibility criteria, not a paper-stated requirement.

selected_operators_note.value: Addresses are used only to take measured round-4364 fee and stake shares. The roles in the scenarios are synthetic. Nothing here describes what any address owner did or intends; address stake is a proxy and no beneficial owner is identified.
selected_operators_note.source: docs/m2/SLICE-02.md, Inputs to freeze at Stage A, Stake and retention row; selected_operators_note: chosen synthetic role assignment on measured shares, with no ownership/behaviour attribution.
